$description: Inner Spark Media, the consulting site (innersparkmedia.com). Flint's neutrals and blue, plus the ISM orange as the accent and focus ring, 8px cards and ISM's lighter shadows.

$source.kept: Navy #0D2B45 (= blue.900), surfaces, borders and Open Sans already match Flint.

swapped.primary blue #1A5FA8 (blue.600): 6.47:1 with a white label, under Flint's 7:1 text bar. Uses Flint's blue.700 #1550A0 (7.82:1), one step darker.
swapped.muted text #4A5568: Not on a Flint ramp and close to Flint's gray.700 #334155. Keeps Flint's muted.
swapped.body text #1A1A2E: Not on a Flint ramp and close to Flint's gray.800 #1E293B. Keeps Flint's default.
swapped.orange #C85A00: 4.27:1 on white. Fails 4.5:1 for text (the site comment says 5.0:1), passes 3:1 for UI. Live site uses it only as the focus outline, so it maps to the focus ring and accent, never to text.

$source.added: No dark mode on the live site. Dark uses Flint's dark values with orange.400 as the focus ring and accent.
